Lines plot type

Source: R/type_system.R
type_lines.Rd

Draws lines connecting data points. Supports individual subject/replicate trajectories via group, automatic calculation of group mean trajectories with standard error bars (mean ± SE) or shaded confidence bands (show_ribbon), horizontal positioning dodge to prevent multi-group collisions, prominent white-stroked mean point glyphs, and overlaid background observation points.

Usage

type_lines(
  linewidth = 1.15,
  alpha = 0.95,
  group = NULL,
  aggregate = c("auto", "mean", "median", "none"),
  add_points = FALSE,
  point_size = 2,
  point_alpha = 0.35,
  show_se = FALSE,
  show_ribbon = FALSE,
  ribbon_alpha = 0.16,
  dodge = 0.45,
  errorbar_width = 0.35,
  errorbar_linewidth = 0.75,
  show_mean_points = TRUE,
  mean_point_size = 3.5
)

Arguments

linewidth

Line width (default 1.15).

alpha

Line transparency (default 0.95).

group

Column name or aesthetic for individual grouping (e.g. "Individual", "Patient").

aggregate

Aggregation mode when duplicate observations exist at the same x: "auto" (default, aggregates by mean if duplicates exist and no group is specified), "mean", "median", or "none".

add_points

Logical. Whether to overlay individual observation points (default FALSE).

point_size

Size of overlaid individual points (default 2.0).

point_alpha

Transparency of overlaid points (default 0.35).

show_se

Logical. Whether to display standard error bars (mean ± SE) (default FALSE).

show_ribbon

Logical. Whether to display a shaded mean ± SE ribbon (default FALSE).

ribbon_alpha

Transparency of shaded ribbon (default 0.16).

dodge

Horizontal position dodge to prevent error bars and points from overlapping across groups (default 0.45 when multiple groups exist, otherwise 0).

errorbar_width

Width of error bar caps (default 0.35).

errorbar_linewidth

Line width of error bars (default 0.75).

show_mean_points

Logical. Whether to place prominent point markers on the mean line (default TRUE when aggregating).

mean_point_size

Size of mean point markers (default 3.5).
